tabs.overview: Boxes arrive full on trucks, stack two high in rows, and are set on a feeder that empties them onto the blender conveyor; no pneumatic transfer, so less dust and noise.
tabs.engineering: Box count from the stage proppant and the truck cycle time.
tabs.safety: Forklift and crane traffic; silica dust controls at the feeder.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout only (S9).

name: Sand boxes (containerized sand)
function: Sand delivered and stored in stackable containers that gravity-feed a conveyor to the blender, the alternative to pneumatic silos.
